evaluate_class_gmm — MV classify op

• Data kinds: table × matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.evaluate_class_gmm(model, features) (to call the implementation directly, import mvclass; mvclass.evaluate_class_gmm(model, features); from the registry, opsmv.get("evaluate_class_gmm"))

• HALCON equivalent: evaluate_class_gmm (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Return the class posteriors and the overall log density for each row.
